༄༅/ /ya mā ra'i bstod pa phreng ba 'dzin pa can bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// ya mā ra'i bstod pa phreng ba 'dzin pa can bzhugs so//

ya mā ri na mo/ ya mānta ka sya stu ti mā lā dha ra nā ma/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ gtum chen rab 'bar gshin rje 'joms mdzad nyi ma 'bum las lhag pa'i 'od zer rab 'bar zhing*// phyag gi padmar mtshon cha rab mang bskal pa'i me ltar g.yo ba gshin rje'i gshed po khyod// rdo rje'i sku la klu dbang gis brgyan gcan gzan gdug pa'i pags rlon mi dang glang chen ko ba na bzar gsol// mi mgo rlon pa'i phreng bas sku la brgyan cing brkyang bskum zhabs bzhis gshin rje ma he glang rgod mnan// mi bzad khro rgyal zhal gsum hūm̐ phaṭa ā ra li sgras khams gsum rngams shing shigs shigs rab tu 'dar/ sha za'i mgo bcad dbu yi thod du rab bcings spyan ldog tsam gyis bdud kyi ser chen chil chil 'bebs// ljags 'dril tshems kyi rtse nas rdo rje'i thog chen 'bebs shing 'khor gyi ma mo'i tshogs rnams 'dar zhing 'dud// des na lha klu gnod sbyin rnams ni smos ci dgos te rkan sgra drag po gtog pa tsam gyis kyang*// lha chen khyab 'jug dag kyang kha sbub 'gyel zhing khrag tu skyug pa'i mthu ldan khyed ni e ma 'jigs// stong gsum skad cig mid par bcas pa'i zhal gdangs khro gtum tsha rngam chen po bcas pa nyid kho nas// tshangs pa'i tshogs rnams skrag nas rngul gyi thigs pa 'dzag cing nad gtong srid pa'i tshogs rnams gum gum 'dud// phyag na 'khor lo 'bar zhing rab gnon ral gri dang ni khro bo rdo rje rab tu kha gdangs pa// glog ltar myur ba'i lcags kyu dang ni rab 'jigs gtun shing sdigs mdzub dus mtha'i byin za 'bar ba gdengs// dgra bo'i klad khrag zhal du gsol zhing sgrub pa po la dngos grub chen po dag ni gegs med stsol// khyung dang 'ug pa lta bu'i khram snams dam las ldog pa rnams la gtor zhing dus kyi mthar sgrol byed// gnod sbyin mi bsgrang phreng bas sku la rab brgyan rdo rje brjid pa'i stangs stabs gar gyis sa gsum g.yo// dur khrod chen por mtshan mo rab rgyu ro'i mgo bcad so yis chim chim za zhing khrag kyang 'thung*// 'jig rten lha dang de las 'das pa kun gyis khyod mthong tsam gyis sma 'bebs zhabs la mgo bos 'dud// yon tan bye bas brgyan pa'i lha khyod kyi ni gzi brjid bzod par dka' yang sgrub po bdag 'dud na// gdug pa'i sems kyis bdag dang bdag gi gnod pa'i mi dang mi min 'byung po gang su dag

/khug cig zung zhig rgyob cig chings shig drag pos sgrol la phung khams skye mched zhal du kha raṃ khā hi// bdag gi yun gyi lha yang khyod la gsol ba 'debs kyi ri rab gser gyi ngos la gnas pa yi// 'dab chags rnams ni bya yi rang bzhin bor nas gser du snang ba kho na dag ni ji bzhin du// snang grag chos rnams khyod kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs su rtag par bdag gis rtse gcig rab bsgoms nas// bdag ni tha mal rang bzhin bor nas khro rgyal khyod kyi sku gsung thugs su 'bad med rab gyur te| |lha mchog khyod nyid yi dam sus bsten mi yi tha ma rnams kyang rab mchog dag pa nyid du 'gyur// de bas bdag gis 'di dang pha rol gnyis kar srog gi phyir yang lha khyod mi gtang sgrub lags na// byams pa'i zhal bzang dngos su bdag la myur ston thugs rje'i spyan gyis bdag la g.yel med bskyang du gsol// khyed ltar bdag 'gyur de phyir bstod cing phyag 'tshal yun ring gong nas bdag gis lha khyod bsgrubs lags kyi// khyod kyis bdag la dngos grub rnam gnyis dang ni re 'dod 'bras bu mtha' dag da lta nyid du bstsal du gsol// kā la rū pa bdag hrīḥṣṭī ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'ang zla gsang gi rgyud las 'khor rnams kyis gtum chen la bstod pa'i skabs kyi tshigs bcad thung ngu rnams/ slar phreng ba 'dzin pa'i sdeb sbyor gyis bcings shing bsdus pa 'di'ang*/ 'bri gung pa sngags 'chang chos kyi grags pas bsdebs te bris pa'i dge bas sems can thams cad 'jam mgon dge ba'i bshes kyi go 'phang dam pa myur du thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ bha wantu//
